comparison.objective: Rotate a shaft in V-blocks to measure runout while keeping it seated; candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated shaft regrasping and constrained rotation under an indicator versus bimanual counterholding during locknut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Requires 90–360° counted rotation, seating/end-gap control, a valid runout reading, and release; candidate requires a 90° retained stop over three close-open cycles.
comparison.reason: The record measures in-place inspection rotation without lift, whereas the candidate measures adjustment preservation under tightening reaction and subsequent functional cycling.
